output.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM (SELECT o.customer_id FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING SUM(o.net_revenue) > 50000) AS c
output.explanation: Counts customers whose net revenue from completed orders placed in calendar year 2025 exceeds 50,000 EUR. Shipping fees are excluded.
